strings.notes_voice_transcript_dictation_active_: Kunyora nezwi kunoramba kuchishanda kusvikira wabaya Misa.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_body: Kuziva mashoko online kazhinji kwakanyatsojeka nokuti kunogona kushandisa mabasa esisitimu kana egore emudziyo. Maitiro offline anoshanda pasina internet, asi kunaka kunogona kuderera nokuti kugadzirisa kunoitwa pafoni uye kunoenderana nemodheru yakasarudzwa.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_model_mis: Modheru offline haisati yaiswa. Kudhaunirodha kuchawedzerwa padanho remodule offline.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_locked: Zvirongwa hazvigoni kuchinjwa kunyora nezwi kuchiri kushanda. Tanga wamisa kuziva mashoko.
strings.notes_transcript_offline_model_missing: Modheru yekuziva mashoko pasina internet haina kuiswa.
strings.settings_speech_models_button_body: Dhaunirodha uye gadzirisa mamodheru ekushandura inzwi kuva mashoko pasina internet.
strings.settings_speech_models_header_body: Dhaunirodha mamodheru ezwi ekushandura inzwi kuva mashoko pasina internet. Mamodheru anochengetwa pamudziyo uye anoongororwa neSHA-256 asati aiswa.
strings.settings_speech_models_load_failed: Kutadza kurodha manifest yemamodheru ezwi. Tarisa kubatana kwako woedza zvakare.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_no_models: Hapana mamodheru offline akaiswa. Vhura Mamodheru ezwi offline muZvirongwa uye tanga wadhaunirodha modheru.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_h: Kuziva mashoko offline kunoshanda pasina internet. Kunaka kunoenderana nemodheru yakasarudzwa, kushanda kwefoni nemamiriro emakrofoni. Kuti uwane kunyatsojeka kukuru, shandisa kuziva mashoko online.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_s: Kunaka kweoffline kunogona kuderera kupfuura online nokuti kugadzirisa kunoitwa pafoni.
strings.geo_alarm_empty_body: Gadzira aramu inoenderana nenzvimbo yekupinda kana kubuda munzvimbo yakasarudzwa.
strings.geo_alarm_stage1_body: Danho iri rinochengeta maaramu enzvimbo, kuongorora nedata rebackup. Mvumo dzenzvimbo nekutumirwa kwegeofence chaiko zvichabatanidzwa padanho rinotevera.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_latitude: Latitude inofanira kuva pakati pe-90 ne90.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_longitude: Longitude inofanira kuva pakati pe-180 ne180.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_data: Tarisa data rearamu yenzvimbo woedza zvakare.
strings.settings_diagnostics_geo_alarm_body: Zviitiko zvekugadzira, kugadzirisa, backup, kudzorera nekutumirwa kwegeofence mune ramangwana.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_log_empty_body: Gadzira kana rongedza maaramu enzvimbo uye chinyorwa chezviitiko chichaonekwa pano.
strings.geo_alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Zviitiko zvose zvekuongorora aramu yenzvimbo zvakachengetedzwa zvichadzimwa zvachose.
strings.geo_alarm_stage2_body: Mvumo dzenzvimbo nekunyoreswa kwegeofence zvakabatanidzwa. Kana nzvimbo yakachengetedzwa yatanga, app inonyora kuongorora uye inoratidza chiziviso. Kurira kwakazara kuchabatanidzwa padanho rinotevera.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_package2_body: Kunyoreswa kwegeofence, kudzorerwa pakutanga, transition receiver, kuongorora nekutumirwa kwezviziviso zvakabatidzwa.
strings.geo_alarm_reliability_body: Maaramu anoenderana nenzvimbo anoda mvumo yenzvimbo, nzvimbo yekumashure nezviziviso. Android inogona kunonotsa zviitiko zvegeofence kuti ichengetedze bhatiri.
strings.geo_alarm_permission_precise_missing: Nzvimbo yekufungidzira chete kana hapana nzvimbo
strings.geo_alarm_vendor_hint_body: PaXiaomi, Redmi, POCO, MIUI kana HyperOS, bvumirawo kutanga yega uye bvisa miganhu yebhatiri paShiftAlarm. Zvikasadaro zviitiko zvegeofence zvinogona kunonoka.
strings.geo_alarm_stage21_body: Danho iri rinowedzera nzira pfupi dzemvumo, mazano ekuvimbika nekuongorora kwakadzama. Kurira kwakazara kuchabatanidzwa mushure mekusimbiswa kwemaitiro egeofence.
strings.geo_alarm_ringing_channel_description: Ruzha, kudengenyeka nezviziviso zvechidzitiro chose zvearamu yenzvimbo
strings.geo_alarm_cooldown_hint_body: Kutanga kwakadzokororwa kweshanduko imwe chete yearamu yenzvimbo kunogona kusateererwa kwemaminitsi mashoma kudzivisa kurira kaviri pedyo nemuganhu wenzvimbo.
strings.geo_alarm_duplicate_protection_body: Dziviriro yekudzokorora: chiitiko chimwe chete chekupinda kana kubuda hachizoriri zvakare kwemaminitsi 3. Chiitiko chakapesana chinogona kurira.
strings.geo_alarm_map_location_unavailable: Nzvimbo yazvino haisi kuwanikwa. Edza zvakare uri panze kana tarisa zvirongwa zvenzvimbo.
strings.geo_alarm_map_provider_later: Google Maps, Yandex Maps, satellite nemarukoko emusanganiswa zvakachengeterwa mapakeji anotevera. Pakeji yazvino inoshandisa OpenStreetMap.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_step_hint: Radius inoshanduka nematanho e200 m. Pamusoro-soro: 5000 m.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_reliability_warning: Radius iri pasi pe800 m inogona kutanga kunonoka nokuda kwekuchengetedza bhatiri nekunyatsojeka kwenzvimbo.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_android_hint: Kuti aramu yenzvimbo ishande zvakavimbika, 800–1000 m inokurudzirwa.
strings.geo_alarm_map_search_not_found: Kero haina kuwanikwa. Edza mubvunzo wakazara: guta, mugwagwa nenhamba yeimba.
strings.geo_alarm_map_reverse_geocode_online_fir: Kutsvaga kero kunotanga nekushandisa data online, kozoshandisa geocoder yemudziyo kana network isipo.
strings.geo_alarm_trigger_hint: Aramu yenzvimbo ichabatidzwa kana mamiriro enzvimbo akasarudzwa aonekwa.
strings.geo_alarm_location_hint_read_only: Poinzi yasarudzwa pamepu. Pano unogona kugadzirisa kero inoratidzwa chete.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_type_hint: Aramu iyi inoshandisa nzvimbo yakasarudzwa pamepu panzvimbo penguva yewachi.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_disabled_hint: Batidza aramu yenzvimbo pachidzitiro chemepu kuti unyore geofence yayo.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_ready_hint: Mvumo dzagadziriswa. Kunyoreswa kwearamu yenzvimbo kunofanira kushanda.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_location_hint: Bvumira mvumo yenzvimbo kuti unyore nzvimbo yakasarudzwa.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_background_hint: Bvumira kuwana nzvimbo nguva dzose kuti itange zvakavimbika kana app yakavharwa.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_notification_hint: Bvumira zviziviso kuti aramu yenzvimbo iratidze zviziviso zvekurira.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_google_play_hint: Google Play services inodiwa paAndroid geofencing pamudziyo uyu.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_setup_hint: Chengetedza aramu yenzvimbo uye app ichanyora geofence.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_error_hint: Tarisa mvumo nekuongorora kana kunyoreswa kukakundikana.
strings.alarm_duration_hint: Aramu ichamira yega mushure menguva yakasarudzwa.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_always_hint: Aramu yenzvimbo inoshanda zuva rega rega yakabatidzwa.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_one_time_hint: Mushure mekutanga kwakabudirira kwekutanga, aramu yenzvimbo ichadzimwa.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_repeat_days_hint: Aramu yenzvimbo inorira pamazuva evhiki akasarudzwa chete.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_shift_linked_hin: Aramu yenzvimbo inorira pamashifiti ebasa akasarudzwa chete.
strings.geo_alarm_repeat_days_required: Sarudza zuva rimwe chete rearamu yenzvimbo iyi.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_empty: Hapana hurongwa hweshifiti parizvino. Tanga wagadzira hurongwa.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_body: Aramu yenzvimbo iyi inoshandisa hurongwa hweshifiti hunoshanda chete.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_required: Batidza hurongwa hweshifiti usati wachengetedza aramu yenzvimbo yakasungirirwa kushifiti.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_timing_body: Sarudza kana aramu yenzvimbo iyi ichishanda pazuva reshifiti, zuva risati rasvika, kana zuva rinotevera.
strings.geo_alarm_bookmark_remove_alarm_confirm_: Chinyorwa chenzvimbo yakachengetedzwa chete ndicho chichabviswa. Aramu yenzvimbo pachayo icharamba iripo.
strings.geo_alarm_bookmark_remove_point_confirm_: Poinzi iyi yakachengetedzwa chete ndiyo ichabviswa. Maaramu enzvimbo haachinjwi.
strings.geo_alarm_map_location_permission_body: Bvumira mvumo yenzvimbo kuti uratidze nzvimbo yako yazvino pamepu.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_no_active: Hapana hurongwa hweshifiti hunoshanda. Tanga wabatidza hurongwa hweshifiti.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_active_body: Aramu yenzvimbo iyi ichasungirirwa kuhurongwa hweshifiti hunoshanda.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_inactive_body: Aramu yenzvimbo iyi yakasungirirwa kuhurongwa hweshifiti husiri kushanda zvino.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_before_window_dialog_tit: Batidza nguva yakareba sei zvisati zvaitika
strings.geo_alarm_shift_before_window_body: Aramu yenzvimbo inoshanda mukati menguva iyi chete shifiti isati yatanga.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_after_until_crossing_val: Inoshanda shifiti yapera kusvika pakuyambuka geofence kwekutanga
strings.geo_alarm_shift_after_until_crossing_bod: Kana geofence isina kuyambukwa, kutanga kwakamirira mushure meshifiti kunogadziriswazve kana shifiti inotevera yatanga kana pakupera kwezuva.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_after_until_crossing_she: Inoshanda shifiti yapera kusvika pakuyambuka geofence kwekutanga
strings.geo_alarm_map_offline_cache_body: Mepu icharatidza nzvimbo dzakachengetedzwa kana dzakambovhurwa. Nzvimbo dzisipo dzicharodha zvakare kana internet yava kuwanikwa.
strings.widget_config_4x3_body: Sarudza mabhatani maviri eruzivo. Nhasi newachi zvinogara zvichiratidzwa pamusoro.
strings.widget_config_calendar_4x4_v2_body: Sarudza mabhatani maviri mapfupi. Karenda nehurongwa hwemangwana zvinogara zvichiratidzwa.
strings.widget_config_calendar_4x4_v3_body: Kujeka kwemashure chete ndiko kunogona kugadziriswa.
strings.alarm_repeat_after_ignored_body: Kana ukasamisa kana kunonotsa, aramu icharira zvakare.
strings.settings_speech_models_download_continue: Kudhaunirodha mamodheru kunoenderera kunyange ukabuda pachidzitiro ichi.
strings.settings_permissions_alarm_geo_summary_b: Gadzirisa kuvimbika kwemaaramu ekumuka, kuwana nzvimbo kwemaaramu enzvimbo nezvirongwa zvebhatiri panzvimbo imwe.
strings.settings_permissions_geo_first_launch_bo: Maaramu enzvimbo anoda kuwana nzvimbo, nzvimbo chaiyo nenzvimbo yekumashure kuti atange kana app yakavharwa. Unogona kuzvibvumira muzvirongwa zveapp.
strings.settings_permissions_unrestricted_body: Kuti maaramu nemaaramu enzvimbo ashande zvakavimbika, bvisa miganhu yebhatiri paShiftAlarm. PaXiaomi/Redmi nemidziyo yakafanana, bvumirawo kutanga yega/kushanda kumashure kana zvichiwanikwa.
strings.settings_backup_save_body: Gadzira faira rebackup uye sarudza parinofanira kuchengetedzwa pamudziyo uyu.
strings.settings_backup_share_body: Gadzira faira rebackup uye vhura peji rekugovera resisitimu kuti uritumire kuemail, messenger kana nzvimbo yegore.
strings.settings_backup_export_share_success_bod: Sarudza kwaunoda kutumira kana kurodha faira rebackup.
strings.settings_backup_export_share_error_body: Kutadza kugadzira kana kugovera faira rebackup.
strings.shifts_salary_deduction_constant_carry_h: Zvinobviswa zvisingachinji zvinoendeswa kumwedzi unotevera zvoga.
strings.settings_legal_button_body: Vhura mitemo, mutemo wekuvanzika, chiziviso chekusava nemhosva negwaro remushandisi.
strings.legal_documents_intro_body: Magwaro anowanikwa pasina internet. Kana internet iripo, ShiftAlarm inogona kudhaunirodha shanduro dzazvino uye kushandisa makopi ari muapp kana kudhaunirodha kukakundikana.
strings.legal_disclaimer_body: Miganhu yakakosha yekuvimbika kwemaaramu, zviziviso nemageofence.
strings.legal_help_body: Gwaro risingadi internet remabasa makuru eapp.
strings.legal_document_unavailable_body: Gwaro harina kuvhurika. Tarisa kubatana kana edza zvakare gare gare.
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_body: ShiftAlarm inosanganisa hurongwa hweshifiti, maaramu, maaramu enzvimbo, zvinyorwa, mawidget nezvishandiso zvebackup. Chidzitiro chikuru chiri kutowanikwa kuseri kwehwindo iri rekugadzirisa.
strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Vhura magwaro eapp uye bvuma shanduro dzinodiwa. Anotsanangura mitemo yekushandisa, kuvanzika nemiganhu yekuvimbika kwemaaramu, zviziviso nemaaramu enzvimbo.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: Mvumo hadzidiwi kuti uongorore app, asi maaramu, zviyeuchidzo nemaaramu enzvimbo zvinotsamira pazviziviso, maaramu chaiwo, nzvimbo nezvirongwa zvebhatiri.
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Unogona kupedza zvino wodzokera kumvumo gare gare kubva muZvirongwa.
strings.settings_help_training_button_body: Vhura gwaro remushandisi risingadi internet muhwindo rebrowser rakasiyana.
strings.help_training_offer_body: Vhura gwaro remushandisi kuti udzidze zvinoitwa nebasa guru rega rega, pariri, zvekubaya nezvekutarisa kana chimwe chinhu chikasashanda sezvaitarisirwa.
strings.help_training_offer_hint: Gwaro rinovhurika sepeji remuno rakasiyana, saka unogona kuchinjana pakati pegwaro neapp uchitevera matanho.
strings.help_training_offer_open_failed: Gwaro harina kuvhurika. Edza zvakare kubva muZvirongwa.

strings.settings_documents_instruction_group_bod: Magwaro, rubatsiro, kudzidziswa negwaro remushandisi zvakaunganidzwa pano.
